 Chase McLaughlin connects on three field goals Sunday 
 by Ari Koslow | Buccaneers Correspondent | Sun, Nov 1st 2026, 11:30pm EST 
 Chase McLaughlin connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt on Sunday. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Despite brutal weather, it didn't stop McLaughlin from hitting field goals from 46, 34 and 42 yards out in the first half. He remains one of the top kickers in fantasy football this season.
